option_A.name: strict exact admission
option_A.requirement: every observed stopping edge exactly reconstructable
option_A.pros: strongest numerical evidence; cleanly separates numeric vs physics
option_A.cons: needs debug output for decision-step stops; extra engineering dependency; not portable across environments

option_B.name: tiered admission
option_B.requirement: exact for normal/non-action; bounded for decision-stop; not-evaluable for discontinuity; pre-declared anomaly stop rule
option_B.pros: preserves observational uncertainty explicitly; unblocks B1.2 engineering; no hidden circular inference
option_B.cons: cannot claim all stopping edges exactly equivalent; needs pre-approved non-evaluable fraction and stop policy; insufficient if conclusions are sensitive to exact stopping displacement

recommendation: Option B is the defensible engineering path IF the researcher pre-approves the bounded/not-evaluable policy; Option A remains available as a separately authorised debug-instrumentation task. Codex does NOT approve Option B unilaterally.
